implementation.targetScope: React19 useTable selectors, source/table subscriptions, FlexRender, current legacy migration hook and Table8 useReactTable compatibility for the flat-data MRT caller. Advanced createTableHook component registries, experimental workers, unsupported core features and a general React Store package are excluded.

changes: Independent React hooks use useSyncExternalStore and VPM Store directly; no upstream React Table or React Store runtime ships.
Current render views retain selected state snapshots while core/store identities persist; legacy table identity stays stable.
Callbacks are published at commit and suppressed after disposal; abandoned renders cannot replace mounted handlers.
Option-driven subscription notifications are deferred to commit to avoid cross-component updates during render; subscription disposal removes pending notifications.
Removing controlled state/callback props returns ownership to the table.
The Table8 compatibility hook fills missing controlled pagination fields from initial defaults, preserving page-size-only MRT initialization.

caller.name: material-react-table
caller.scope: Reusable DataTable currently mounted by the products/orders templates. User intends to reuse table capabilities in math/contest features; no new app feature or adoption is claimed.
